info.title: Jayburd Ledger Contract
info.description: Implemented ledger, reporting and source review contract. Synthetic development policy only; no live-use approval. SQL owns semantics. Internal operations are not registered ISO financial messages. Public application posting requires retained source evidence; standalone manual entry is unsupported.

get.summary: List currently readable books and setup currency references
get.description: Requires an enrolled active principal. Only active entity/book scopes with read permission are included. Current permission checks serialize with local revocation; no inferred grants. Limits: 100 entities, 200 books total, 200 accounts per book, 100 policies and 240 periods per book, 1000 currencies and 1 MiB response. Exceeding bounds fails with 413 instead of partial data. Internal UI discovery; not an ISO 20022 financial exchange.

post.summary: Store an immutable reviewed command without executing it
post.description: Current identity and scoped permissions are rechecked. Internal recovery control, not an ISO20022 message. See command-recovery.md. One unacknowledged command per principal. Same registration key and content replay; changed content or other pending work conflicts. Public registration rejects manual post with 422 artifact_required; source_post must reference the exact retained source review/draft. Setup and import do not post journals.

post.summary: Clear the owner's inaccessible saved command
post.description: Explicit internal recovery control, not an ISO20022 message. Requires an exact empty object. Only the owning principal's currently inaccessible unacknowledged command qualifies. Prepared work is cancelled and acknowledged; terminal work is acknowledged. No saved payload, scope, result or financial data is returned, and no accounting operation executes.

200.description: Whether an inaccessible saved command was cleared in this transaction.

post.summary: Execute the stored immutable command or replay its result
post.description: Current identity and scoped permissions are rechecked. Internal recovery control, not an ISO20022 message. See command-recovery.md. Uses stored command identity and immutable body; repeating this transition cannot authorize a different operation. A prepared legacy manual post returns 422 artifact_required. Current pending identity is checked within the same serializable transaction as execution; historical committed command receipts, cancellation and acknowledgement remain under current authority.

post.summary: Cancel a new Sandbox setup without deleting its audit history
post.description: Explicit owner acknowledgement. Unclaimed new link_pending/link_ready attempts and new credential_recovery_required attempts without a stored credential are abandoned locally. A new binding_review or disconnect_pending attempt is fenced, its exact Plaid Item is removed with the stored encrypted credential, and only then is the attempt abandoned. Cancellation never replays exchange or posts journals. See docs/contracts/binding-review-recovery.md.

post.summary: Execute one operator-approved finite Sandbox history adoption plan
post.description: Default absent. Requires separately owner-provisioned workspace, explicit finite approved metadata file and actual managed verified actor matching that plan; caller IDs never establish identity. Exact complete source set/current authority/generation checked by existing SQL in SERIALIZABLE. No provider fetch, new consent, source copying or journal write. Lost reply permits only explicit identical-plan replay while approval remains valid; expiry/denial never establishes absence. No query, Idempotency-Key or content encoding; body1024 bytes, response32768 bytes, no-store. See docs/contracts/private-sandbox-activation.md. Managed operator execution prerequisites remain separate.

FinancialReport.description: Bounded internal review report. Supported synthetic policy only. Totals span complete selected scope, not the page. No ISO audit export or live-policy approval.

Amount.description: Unsigned finite decimal string, up to 29 integer and 9 fractional digits. Validate lexical bounds before casts, then enforce currency minor-unit and functional posting scale by value; no silent rounding of supplied amounts.

Revision.description: Unsigned canonical decimal string, semantic maximum 9223372036854775807. Mutation at maximum fails before writes; no wraparound.

transaction_currency.description: ISO 4217 code; validity and selected metadata version checked by accounting date.

Line.description: First slice accepts identity/spot only. Functional amount is a client assertion independently recomputed under the book policy. The development spot policy uses synthetic same-UTC-date rates, transaction-to-USD direction, exact multiplication and half-even rounding. No automatic balancing adjustment.

functional_currency.description: ISO 4217 code; validity and selected metadata version checked by accounting date.
ISO 4217 code; validity and selected metadata version checked by accounting date.

TrialBalance.description: Cumulative posted balances through date inclusive. Each row has at most one nonzero side; total debits equals total credits. Reject a result exceeding supported amount bounds.

PositiveAmount.description: A strictly positive amount in the first manual-posting slice.

transaction_currency.description: ISO 4217 code; validity and selected metadata version checked by accounting date.

PostedLine.description: Immutable line with resolved currency metadata version and original valuation provenance. The development spot policy uses synthetic same-UTC-date rates, transaction-to-USD direction, exact multiplication and half-even rounding. No automatic balancing adjustment.

RegisterCommand.description: Legacy command vocabulary retained for historical decoding and isolated accounting primitive proof. Public registration uses ArtifactRegisterCommand; new manual post commands are unsupported.

ImportCommandBody.description: Explicit confirmation of one immutable synthetic preview. Imports create review items, never journals. Current source permissions and pinned revisions are checked by SQL.

link_token.description: Ephemeral handoff; memory only, never browser persistence.

hosted_link_url.description: Sandbox Hosted Link handoff; memory only. Open explicitly with noreferrer; keep this tab open.

public_token.description: Omit for Hosted Link completion; server resolves the unique completed session before claiming exchange. Pending returns unchanged link_ready attempt.

delivery_state.description: Durable delivery disposition; HTTP acknowledgement is not publication.

decoder_error.description: Fixed classification from the latest acquisition; never provider data.

provider_updated_at.description: Unknown: webhook receipt time is not provider data-update time.

ConnectionStreamOperation.description: Explicit scoped control. A request signals new demand and may release a proven permanent acquisition failure for a fresh attempt; unknown outcomes remain quarantined. Exact-key replay preserves the original receipt.

ActivityQuery.description: Closed source-activity-v1 private read, <=8192 UTF8 bytes. Summary requires null unit/merchant/cursor and limit20; observations require exact unit and snapshot, limit<=100; merchants require exact unit and snapshot, null merchant, limit<=20. Attributed merchant has nonblank label; other statuses require null. Inclusive real ordered calendar dates. SQL validates conditional constraints and duplicate keys.

partial.description: Incomplete source history; independent of assignment metadata availability.

PrivateLabelPreviewRequest.description: Labels require1–100 exact selections; taxonomy actions require empty selection and retain every existing topic ID. SQL validates these conditional invariants.

PrivateLabelActionV2.description: Add/remove require at least one ID; replacement may be empty. Final per-observation set at most25. Add/replace require active local tags; retired removal allowed. SQL checks conditional limits/current authority.

partial.description: Incomplete source history; independent of assignment metadata availability.

PrivateLabelPreviewRequestV2.description: Labels require1–100 exact selections; taxonomy actions require empty selection and retain every existing topic ID. SQL validates these conditional invariants.

partial.description: Incomplete source history; independent of assignment metadata availability.

value.description: At most128 UTF8 bytes; bounded Go regexp syntax/work validation is authoritative.

PrivateEffectiveRuleOutput.description: More than20 tags are permitted only when the result preserves an existing manual tag field; never a newly authored rule output.

PrivateRuleCatalog.description: Complete immutable edition, at most100 active rules and256KiB serialized rules. Retain existing IDs, terminal retirement, active names case-sensitive unique. Aggregate catalog/preview/command response budget1MiB enforced before accepting new state.

PrivateRuleSuggestion.description: Current matcher proposal only. A read never applies labels, and false is not an authoritative future preview eligibility decision.

PrivateRuleApplication.description: Stored prior applied decision origin, separate from current matching suggestions. No inference of manual origin from a current matching rule.

PrivateLabelPreviewRequestV3.description: Rule catalog edits require empty selection; rule apply requires1–100 exact current observations. SQL pins and explicit persisted preview/prepare/execute/ack are mandatory; no caller-supplied match results.

ArtifactRegisterCommand.description: New public application commands: setup, import and source_post only. A post command without retained source evidence is rejected with 422 artifact_required.

PrivateAutomaticCategorizationCapability.description: Advertised only by explicitly configured automatic categorization composition. Absence means no automatic feature request is implied.

PrivateAutomaticCategorizationRun.description: Bounded durable run metadata. No raw source data, actor-selected results or user acknowledgement is accepted.

PrivateAutomaticCategorizationStatus.description: Current authorized read-only policy and whole-workspace counts. Unknown status is not zero; background work creates no journal or posting outbox.

PrivateAutomaticCategorizationRequest.description: Strict immutable configuration request. Same key/body replay under current authority; unknown outcomes retain the exact original request. No actor, source results or acknowledgement.

PrivateAutomaticProviderAttribution.description: Retained actual provider/version/code/confidence attribution and approved map edition. Reported confidence is not a calibrated application accuracy score or accounting treatment.

PrivateAutomaticCategorization.description: Additive current read projection. Automatic state refers to a durable decision, never an inert suggestion. Rule names are retained at the actual winning edition. Effective owner_topic/owner_tags remain the server-filtered values; historical saved preview shapes are unchanged.

Problem400.description: Malformed request or missing required header.

Problem403.description: Accessible scope but insufficient operation permission.

Problem422.description: Invalid accounting input, missing close evidence or unsupported policy.

Problem503.description: Temporary failure; retry a mutation with the same key and body.

Problem500.description: Unexpected failure; generic redacted explanation and request ID only.
